# `xml_space_before_self_closing`

Space before />. Unset keeps what each tag has, except in .slnx files, which always get one.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `(not set)`

Unset, each tag keeps whether it had a space, and several spaces become one. Solution files always get one, the shape Visual Studio writes.

### `xml_space_before_self_closing = true`

```ini
xml_space_before_self_closing = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```xml
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
    <PropertyGroup>
      <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
        <Description>
          Kept exactly as written: MSBuild reads this whitespace.
        </Description>
    </PropertyGroup>



  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="A"/>
    <PackageReference   Include="B"   Version="1.0" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```xml
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
        <Description>
          Kept exactly as written: MSBuild reads this whitespace.
        </Description>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="A" />
    <PackageReference Include="B" Version="1.0" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
```
:::

::::
